items.title: Attributing projected evapotranspiration and runoff changes to CO2 effect pathways under increasing atmospheric CO2 across global large river basins
items.title_en: Attributing projected evapotranspiration and runoff changes to CO2 effect pathways under increasing atmospheric CO2 across global large river basins
items.title_zh: 在全球大气二氧化碳浓度上升背景下，全球大型河流流域中预计的蒸散量和径流变化归因于二氧化碳效应路径
items.summary_en: Atmospheric CO2 affects terrestrial hydrology through radiative (RAD), vegetation physiological (BGC), and nonlinear interaction (INT) pathways, yet how these pathways drive future evapotranspiration (ET) and runoff (Q) remains poorly understood. We combine idealized CO2 factorial experiments from six CMIP6 Earth System Models with a Budyko-based water-balance framework to quantify pathway contributions to projected ET and Q changes across 38 major global river basins and identify their associated hydrological controlling factors. Projected ET and Q increase in most basins but exhibit pronounced spatial heterogeneity. RAD dominates ET changes in 30 basins, whereas Q changes are dominated by RAD, BGC, and INT in 23, 8, and 7 basins, respectively. In RAD-dominated basins, hydrological changes are primarily associated with hydroclimatic variables, particularly precipitation, whereas the Budyko parameter n, an integrated parameter representing processes not explicitly resolved by the prescribed hydroclimatic variables, is the leading controlling factor in BGC-dominated basins and some INT-dominated basins. These results show that future basin-scale hydrological responses to rising CO2 depend on both the dominant CO2 effect pathway and its associated hydrological regulation, providing a two-level perspective on future terrestrial water-cycle changes.
items.summary_zh: 大气二氧化碳通过辐射（RAD）、植被生理（BGC）和非线性相互作用（INT）等途径影响陆地水文过程，但这些途径如何驱动未来的蒸散发（ET）和径流（Q），目前仍知之甚少。 我们结合了来自六个CMIP6地球系统模型的理想化二氧化碳因子实验，并采用基于布迪科（Budyko）理论的水平衡框架，量化了这些途径对全球38个主要河流流域预计蒸散量和径流变化的贡献，并识别了相关的水文控制因素。 预测显示，大多数流域的ET和Q均将增加，但表现出显著的空间异质性。在30个流域中，辐射（RAD）是ET变化的主导因素；而在23、8和7个流域中，Q的变化则分别主要由RAD、BGC和INT主导。 在以RAD为主导的流域中，水文变化主要与水文气候变量（尤其是降水）相关；而在以BGC为主导的流域以及部分以INT为主导的流域中，布迪科参数n（作为代表预设水文气候变量未明确解析过程的综合参数）则是主要的控制因素。 这些结果表明，未来流域尺度上对二氧化碳浓度上升的水文响应既取决于主要的二氧化碳效应途径，也取决于与其相关的水文调节机制，从而为未来陆地水循环的变化提供了双层面的视角。

items.title: Post-wildfire soil respiration in tundra is driven by plant community composition and soil moisture in the late growing season *
items.title_en: Post-wildfire soil respiration in tundra is driven by plant community composition and soil moisture in the late growing season *
items.title_zh: 苔原地区森林大火后的土壤呼吸受生长季后期植物群落组成和土壤含水量的影响 *
items.summary_en: Arctic wildfires are expected to increase carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions from soils underlain by permafrost. However, we lack in situ measurements of post-fire soil respiration and its drivers in the Arctic tundra. We measured soil properties and late-growing season CO2 fluxes in patches of unique plant functional types (PFT) across two years using a chronosequence approach in tundra recovering from repeated wildfires over the past five decades on the Seward Peninsula of Alaska. Soil respiration varied with wildfire age and number of times burned and was greatest in areas dominated by forbs, declining in areas dominated by shrubs and graminoids. After accounting for PFT, soil respiration also declined as soil moisture increased in already wet systems. Early-thaw season analyses suggested that increased permafrost thaw in burned areas was associated with a denser organic layer. Changes in water availability and plant species composition along post-fire successional trajectories may influence net soil CO2 emissions from Arctic tundra.
items.summary_zh: 预计北极野火将增加永久冻土层下土壤的二氧化碳（CO₂）排放量。然而，我们目前缺乏关于北极苔原地区火灾后土壤呼吸及其驱动因素的原位测量数据。 我们在阿拉斯加苏厄德半岛上，采用时间序列研究方法，对过去五十年间经历过多次野火后正在恢复的苔原地区中，不同独特植物功能类型（PFT）的样地，进行了为期两年的土壤性质及生长季末期二氧化碳通量测量。 土壤呼吸量随野火发生时间的长短和燃烧次数的变化而变化，在草本植物占主导的区域最高，而在灌木和禾本植物占主导的区域则逐渐降低。在控制了植物功能类型（PFT）因素后，在原本湿润的生态系统中，随着土壤含水量的增加，土壤呼吸量也随之下降。 早春融雪期的分析表明，烧毁区域永久冻土融化加剧与有机层密度增加有关。火灾后演替过程中水资源可利用性及植物物种组成变化，可能影响北极苔原的土壤二氧化碳净排放量。

items.title: Contrasting occurrence of winter compound events across different vegetation types in dryland Asia
items.title_en: Contrasting occurrence of winter compound events across different vegetation types in dryland Asia
items.title_zh: 亚洲干旱地区不同植被类型中冬季复合事件发生情况的对比
items.summary_en: Winter compound events characterized by freezing temperatures and heavy snow have profound impacts on vulnerable dryland ecosystems. However, a quantitative evaluation of winter compound events among different vegetation types in dryland Asia remains lacking. In this study, we developed a composite winter compound event index that integrates temperature, snow depth and snow density to investigate the characteristics of the events across different vegetation types over the winter months (November–March) from 2001 to 2024. We show that the year with the widest spatial extent of winter compound events was 2013, affecting approximately 31.52% of the total area of dryland Asia, while the most intense events occurred in 2021. The largest share of cumulative affected area occurs in January, while the intensity peaks in March. Temperature makes the largest relative contribution to event intensity, however, its relative contribution declines in later winter months as the relative contributions of snow depth and snow density increase. Different combinations of contribution rates of temperature, snow depth and snow density shape the divergent event characteristics among vegetation types. The steppe is the major vegetation type across dryland Asia, which experiences the largest event affected area ratio (19.52%), and the highest event frequency (64.19%). Forest cover in dryland Asia is relatively low, but demonstrates the second-highest affected area ratio after steppe and the highest mean intensity of events. These results quantified the occurrence of winter compound events among various vegetation types in dryland Asia, highlighting their different exposure patterns in the dryland ecosystems.
items.summary_zh: 以冰点气温和大雪为特征的冬季复合事件对脆弱的干旱区生态系统产生了深远影响。然而，目前仍缺乏针对亚洲干旱区不同植被类型中冬季复合事件的定量评估。 在本研究中，我们开发了一个综合冬季复合事件指数，该指数整合了温度、积雪深度和积雪密度等指标，用于探究2001年至2024年冬季（11月至3月）不同植被类型中此类事件的特征。 研究表明，冬季复合事件空间范围最广的年份是2013年，影响了亚洲干旱区总面积的约31.52%；而强度最大的事件则发生在2021年。累计受影响面积占比最大的月份是1月，而事件强度在3月达到峰值。 温度对事件强度的相对贡献最大，但随着冬季后期雪深和雪密度的相对贡献增加，温度的相对贡献逐渐下降。 温度、积雪深度和积雪密度的贡献率以不同组合形式，塑造了各类植被类型间各异的事件特征。草原是亚洲干旱区的主要植被类型，其受影响面积占比最大（19.52%），事件发生频率也最高（64.19%）。 亚洲干旱地区的森林覆盖率相对较低，但其受影响面积比例仅次于草原，位居第二，且事件平均强度最高。这些结果量化了亚洲干旱地区各类植被类型中冬季复合事件的发生情况，突显了它们在干旱地区生态系统中的不同暴露模式。

items.summary_zh: 公开信警告称，旨在加快能源和基础设施项目建设的《两党美国可负担性与就业法案》（Baaja）将造成不可逆转的气候危害。随着针对这项全面许可法案的反对声浪日益高涨，120多名气候科学家敦促美国立法者不要通过这项旨在加速能源项目、数据中心及其他基础设施建设的争议性法案。在这封致众议院议员的公开信中，这群地球科学和社会科学研究人员表示“深表关切”，认为《两党美国可负担性与就业法案》（简称Baaja）削弱了环境法律，使新的化石燃料项目无法被撤销，且对导致全球变暖的温室气体排放仅能实现微幅削减。继续阅读……

items.title: October 2026 Temperature Update
items.title_en: October 2026 Temperature Update
items.title_zh: 2026年10月气温更新
items.summary_en: The following is a summary of global temperature conditions in Berkeley Earth’s analysis of October 2026. October 2026 was the warmest October on record, with a global average of 1.80 ± 0.12 °C (3.25 ± 0.22 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, about 0.12 °C above the previous record set in October 2023. By anomaly, it was also nominally the warmest month of any kind since 1850. Land temperatures averaged 2.35 ± 0.14 °C (4.24 ± 0.25 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, nominally the 3rd warmest October for terrestrial regions. Ocean temperatures were 1.34 ± 0.10 °C (2.42 ± 0.18 °F) above the 1850–1900 average, the warmest October on record for ocean surfaces by a clear margin. El Niño continued to strengthen through October and is at record strength. Forecasts now place its peak around December 2026, beyond any event in the modern record. Roughly 14.4% of Earth’s surface experienced its warmest October on record. Record October heat hit mainland Southeast Asia. Vietnam beat its national October record by 0.94 °C in our analysis, with national records also in Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, the Philippines and Thailand. 2026 is now almost certain (~97%) to become the warmest year in Berkeley Earth’s record, up from ~96% in the September update. It is virtually certain to exceed 1.5 °C (2.7 °F) above the 1850–1900 average. Global Summary According to Berkeley Earth’s high-resolution temperature dataset, October 2026 was the warmest October since records began in 1850, with a monthly global average of 1.80 ± 0.12 °C (3.25 ± 0.22 °F) above the 1850–1900 (pre-industrial) average. It finished about 0.12 °C above October 2023, the previous record holder, and the rank is unambiguous once the uncertainties are taken into account. Measured as an anomaly, October 2026 was also nominally the warmest month of any kind among the 2122 months since 1850. Global average temperature for the month of October in each year since 1850, relative to the 1850–1900 average. October 2026 sits at the top of the record, about 0.12 °C above October 2023. October was a slight increase from September and continued the climb that began in mid-year. Global temperatures have moved well above the long-term trend line as the strengthening El Niño adds its warming influence to the global average. Monthly global mean temperature since 1980, relative to the 1850–1900 average, with the long-term trend in red. October 2026 is the highest point on the chart, though within the uncertainty of several earlier months. Global temperature anomaly by calendar month for every year since 1850. The 2026 trace (black) has moved above all prior years for October. The 12-month moving average has turned sharply upward. After falling back toward the long-term trend through 2025 and early 2026, it has risen above the trend line again and is approaching the peak reached in 2024. This short-term variability is an inherent part of the climate system and is expected even alongside persistent long-term global warming. 12-month moving average of global mean temperature with its 95% uncertainty range, plus a 30-year LOWESS smooth (red) indicating the long-term trend. Anomalies are relative to the 1850–1900 average. Spatial Variation In October 2026, warmer-than-average temperatures covered nearly the entire globe. Warmth was especially pronounced across the central and eastern equatorial Pacific, where the El Niño warm tongue dominates the map, and over the Arabian Peninsula, Iran and the Persian Gulf, northern Russia and the Barents Sea, Scandinavia, northern Canada, eastern China and Japan, and the Antarctic Peninsula. The most notable cool anomaly covered Argentina and Paraguay, which were unusually cool for October against their own history. October 2026 surface temperature anomalies relative to the 1951–1980 average. The warm tongue along the equatorial Pacific reflects the strong El Niño. Gray areas, in parts of east-central Africa and coastal Antarctica, indicate regions with insufficient data this month. Roughly 14.4% of Earth’s surface experienced its locally warmest October on record (about 10.4% of land and 16.4% of ocean surfaces). Record warmth covered a large part of the tropical Pacific, the tropical and subtropical North Atlantic, the Arabian Peninsula and Persian Gulf, the Arabian Sea and much of the tropical Indian Ocean, mainland Southeast Asia and the South China Sea, equatorial Africa, northern South America, much of the South Atlantic. The eastern tropical Pacific warmth is due to the current El Niño event. Broad warmth continuing to extend across much of the tropics is also a common feature during Super El Niño events. Near-record cold for October was confined to a small part of East Antarctica, South America, and a few scattered patches of ocean. How October 2026 ranked locally against all Octobers since 1850. items.summary_zh: 以下是伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）对2026年10月全球气温状况分析的摘要。2026年10月是有记录以来最暖的10月，全球平均气温比1850–1900年的平均值高出1.80 ± 0.12 °C （3.25 ± 0.22 °F），比1850–1900年的平均值高出1.80 ± 0.12 °C，比2023年10月创下的此前纪录高出约0.12 °C。按异常值计算，这也是自1850年以来名义上最暖的任何月份。 陆地平均气温较1850–1900年平均值高出2.35 ± 0.14 °C（4.24 ± 0.25 °F），名义上成为陆地地区有记录以来第三暖的10月。 海表温度较1850–1900年平均值高出1.34 ± 0.10 °C（2.42 ± 0.18 °F），这是有记录以来海表温度最高的10月，且优势明显。厄尔尼诺现象在整个10月持续增强，目前已达到有记录以来的最强水平。 当前预测显示，其峰值将出现在2026年12月左右，这将超过现代有记录以来的任何一次厄尔尼诺事件。 地球表面约14.4%的区域经历了有记录以来最热的10月。东南亚大陆地区遭遇了创纪录的10月高温。根据我们的分析，越南的10月气温比该国历史纪录高出0.94 °C，柬埔寨、老挝、缅甸、菲律宾和泰国也均刷新了各自的10月全国纪录。 2026年几乎可以确定（概率约为97%）将成为伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）有记录以来最暖的一年，这一概率较9月份更新的约96%有所上升。 该年气温较1850–1900年平均值高出1.5 °C（2.7 °F）的可能性几乎已成定局。 全球概况 根据伯克利地球（Berkeley Earth）的高分辨率气温数据集，2026年10月是自1850年有记录以来最暖的10月，全球月平均气温较1850–1900年（工业革命前）平均值高出1.80 ± 0.12 °C (3.25 ± 0.22 °F)，较1850–1900年（工业革命前）平均值高出1.80 ± 0.12 °C。该数值比此前保持纪录的2023年10月高出约0.12 °C，且在考虑不确定性后，其排名毫无疑问。 若以异常值衡量，2026年10月在1850年以来2122个月中，名义上也是所有月份中温度最高的。 自1850年以来各年10月的全球平均气温，相对于1850–1900年的平均值。2026年10月位居榜首。
